question.text: The element playing significant role in neuromuscular function and interneuronal transmission is :

solution.text: About 99 % of body calcium is present in bones and teeth. Calcium plays important role in neuromuscular function, interneuronal transmission. Cell membrane integrity and blood coagulation. An adult body contains about <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1200</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ca</mi></math>.
